payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulate alternating subtraction of increasing step values from a and b until one becomes negative, determining who fails first.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively iterates through each step, which is a form of complete enumeration. Among the given subtypes, permutation enumeration is the closest fit despite no actual permutations, as other subtypes (DFS/BFS, branch and bound, backtracking, bitmask) are clearly not applicable.
